title: The Beckoning Hand, and Other Stories
sourceTitle: The Beckoning Hand, and Other Stories
author: Grant Allen
description: "The Beckoning Hand, and Other Stories" by Grant Allen is a collection of short stories written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The tales delve into themes of intrigue, mystery, and human relationships, featuring a diverse array of characters and situations.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Grant Blairfindie Allen was a Canadian science writer and novelist, educated in England. He was a public promoter of evolution in the second half of the nineteenth century.
